fields.description: Multi Vendor runs the full marketplace. Single Company sells only the operator's own products.
fields.label: Mode

fields.description: Single Company mode only: the seller record this store sells as. Products belonging to any OTHER vendor stay out of the storefront entirely. Leave empty and the single Active vendor is used.
fields.label: Store's own seller

fields.description: The language every customer message is written in unless that shopper chose otherwise. Frappe stamps new logins with the SITE language (usually English), which is not a choice the shopper made — this is what the store actually speaks.
fields.label: Default store language

fields.description: Operator: one shipping rate table you manage for all vendors. Per Vendor: each vendor sets their own shipping (flat, free over a threshold, or always free), summed per vendor at checkout and paid into that vendor's settlement.
fields.label: Shipping mode

fields.description: Also mirror approved products as webshop Website Items. Off by default — the Ovira storefront is the primary shopfront.
fields.label: Sync to webshop Website Item

fields.description: Sales Taxes and Charges Template applied to every vendor Sales Order (e.g. inclusive Egypt VAT). Leave blank to use the company default.
fields.label: Sales tax template

fields.description: Income account that receives the shipping fee (billed on the first vendor Sales Order). Leave blank to keep shipping out of ERPNext invoices.
fields.label: Shipping income account

fields.description: Warehouse used for products with inventory tracking on: opening stock is received here, and a Delivery Note draws from it when an order ships. Leave blank to use the company's default warehouse.
fields.label: Default warehouse

fields.description: Liability account tracking outstanding customer store credit. Leave blank to keep wallet movements out of the general ledger (ledger-only mode).
fields.label: Store credit liability account

fields.description: Let shoppers earn points on completed orders and redeem them for store credit. Off by default.
fields.label: Enable loyalty points

fields.description: Points earned per 1 unit of net goods spend (subtotal minus discount). E.g. 1 = one point per EGP.
fields.label: Earn rate (points per currency)

fields.description: Store-credit value of one point at redemption. E.g. 0.01 = 100 points is worth 1 EGP.
fields.label: Redeem value (currency per point)

fields.description: Fewest points a shopper can redeem at once (0 = no minimum).
fields.label: Minimum redeemable points

fields.description: Product featured in the homepage "Deal of the day" card. Leave blank to auto-pick the best in-stock discount.
fields.label: Deal of the day product

fields.description: VAPID public key. Web push stays off until this + the private key are set (and the pywebpush library is installed).
fields.label: VAPID public key

fields.description: VAPID subject (a mailto: or https: contact).
fields.label: VAPID subject

fields.options: When a return is the vendor's fault, the refund is charged back to that vendor: their settlement is debited the refunded amount, and the commission originally taken on it is returned to them minus the administration fee below. Store or goodwill fault is absorbed by the operator instead. Leave Charge vendor off to absorb every refund.

fields.label: Charge refunds back to the vendor
fields.description: Only applies to returns marked as the vendor's fault.

fields.label: Refund administration fee (% of commission)
fields.description: Share of the original commission the operator keeps when returning it. Amazon-style; 20% is their classic figure.

fields.label: Administration fee cap
fields.description: Maximum fee per return in the base currency. 0 = no cap.

fields.options: Screens cash-on-delivery orders before they are created. A blocked order is refused at checkout (generic message, so a fraudster isn't told which rule caught them); a flagged order is created normally but held in the review queue so someone can call before dispatch. Every threshold at 0 disables that individual check.

fields.label: Max undelivered COD orders per customer
fields.description: Flag for review once the buyer already has this many COD orders in flight. 0 = off.

fields.label: Hard COD value ceiling
fields.description: Refuse COD above this amount and ask for prepayment. 0 = no ceiling.

fields.label: First-order COD ceiling
fields.description: Flag a first-time buyer ordering above this. 0 = off.

fields.label: Max refusal rate (%)
fields.description: Flag once the buyer refuses more than this share of their decided COD orders (needs 3+). 0 = off.

fields.options: Marketing messages are held during these hours and sent when they end. Transactional messages (receipts, shipping, delivery codes) always go out immediately. Set both to the same value to disable.

Points earned from now on expire this many days after they are earned, and simply drop out of the balance — no accounting entry, because points were never booked as a liability. Set to 0 to switch expiry off. Points earned BEFORE you set this keep no expiry date: you cannot retroactively expire points somebody already earned.
